scope: Version the existing engineering task to preserve prose-quality observations as immutable review evidence instead of aborting before critics, without relaxing source, schema, authorization or acceptance boundaries.
riskAnalysis: Only closed prose heuristics become review observations in the exact new v4 task. Schema type/shape/size, source preimage and grammar, evidence/criteria coverage, placeholders, original QA/Auditor provenance and all permission/usage/cleanup checks remain fatal. Every observation requires bound reviewer references and mandatory rejection; final-only observations prevent a trusted technical pass. Preserve all historical request bytes and uncertainty.

threatModel.assets: Immutable stage receipts and quality facts, exact source/task/release identity, review attribution, spending records and publication/acceptance restrictions.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Untrusted model prose versus backend-derived closed observations; syntactic quality versus integrity; automated technical review versus independent acceptance; data-only patch worker versus generated execution.
threatModel.abuseCases: Model clears or forges warnings, copies another workspace receipt, omits required quality refs, fabricates pass after prior or final-only warnings, alters evidence/source/patch grammar, revives old policy, or conceals failed-stage usage.
threatModel.mitigations: V4-only exact objective/policy; receipt-hashed derived path/code metadata, ordered prior refs, binding/hash/recomputation checks, Auditor/final enum and backend fail constraints, trusted final outcome, unchanged source/authority/token/cleanup guards and frozen v1/v2/v3 contracts.

defects.rootCause: A genuine Specialist HTTP200 response was stopped by a prose heuristic before QA/Auditor. Exact rejected text was not retained; actual false-positive status is unknown. Independent complete-English fixtures prove the heuristic is not a reliable semantic quality boundary.
defects.detectionGap: Prior checks treated selected word endings as incomplete statements and made ordinary report quality fatal to the whole workflow, preventing the actual independent technical critics from examining it.
defects.regression: Actual owner controller/CAS plus real data-copy workers exercise all five warning stages, clean automated pass without human acceptance, final-only machine failure, forged refs/metadata, source/evidence/schema denial, exact counting and cleanup. Thirty historical golden requests and both actual v3 request/context hashes remain exact.
defects.historicalPrevention: Separate enforceable integrity and authority failures from reviewable prose observations, keep observations immutable and explicitly unresolved, and let critics report evidence without claiming semantic proof or acceptance.

defects.rootCause: A new profile was initially omitted from a duplicated fixture byte-versus-token planning selector. Full ordinary operations fixture coverage found it before any v4 paid request.
defects.detectionGap: Live-controller-only fixtures did not cover the classic rehearsal route, allowing version predicates to diverge across the same feature.
defects.regression: One registry-bound requiresProviderCount predicate supplies both request paths and compatibility metadata. Full ordinary five-stage fixture and thirty frozen request bodies pass without raising byte/token limits.
defects.historicalPrevention: Search every consumer of a versioned capability, centralize its predicate and verify complete live-controller and fixture paths before publishing.

rollback: Keep paid execution disabled, revoke current grants and stop the sequence. Retain original v1-v4 task definitions, request/failure receipts and financial uncertainty. Revert behavior only through a reviewed feature successor, never erase evidence or revive old approvals.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Wrong types/shape/length, extra properties, placeholders, source/evidence/patch and review-reference violations remain fatal; only typed prose observations are non-fatal.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact source/release/task and old-consent denial remain; old v3 behavior and request hashes are frozen.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing serial owner controller/CAS and one-time grant controls remain; UI canonical journal routes the new exact policy without parallel dispatch or automatic retry.
negativePaths.cancellation: Existing cancellation/revocation/cleanup remains authoritative and is exercised by focused count-denial and full STRICT/Redis release coverage. No worker permission changed.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Real restricted data-copy worker lifecycle and cleanup are unchanged; generated source stays inert and source-test permission remains unavailable for this task.
negativePaths.api-outage: Provider/count errors remain fatal with usage diagnostics, no automatic retries or fabricated stage success. Quality annotations do not replace transport evidence.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Source/owner/workspace/grant and policy checks remain fatal; forged/cross-workspace quality receipts and model refs cannot create authority.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Existing monitoring policy and original ledger history remain unchanged, actual token usage is separate from uncertain fees; request/count/token/time ceilings remain enforced.
negativePaths.partial-execution: The failed v3 stage and observed usage are preserved. V4 quality-only observations remain inside immutable validated receipts for later critics; final outcomes explicitly prevent technical acceptance when unresolved.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse the five existing roles, controller, journals, providers and disposable data-copy machinery. New exact task version and review metadata only; no competing orchestrator.
proactiveReview.dependencies: No package, credential, infrastructure or model migration. Existing authenticated task snapshot and cryptographic receipt helpers are reused.
proactiveReview.threats: Model warning suppression or forged receipt metadata must not cross the trusted review boundary; scalar source and authorization guards remain fatal.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Preserve omitted-ref, wrong-workspace/source, count denial, invalid patch, clipped narrative, final-only issue and cleanup failure evidence without claiming unobserved original text.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Focused actual-controller fixtures mutate every role, receipt metadata and source/evidence binding. Ordinary fixture route uses the real restricted data-copy worker without generated execution.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent QA and Auditor reviewed the design and implementation. Auditor found omitted no/not criterion observations; these are preserved and regression-tested before release.
proactiveReview.recovery: After each attempt preserve original receipts and usage, revoke grants, stop paid authority and qualify any exact successor before another distinct attempt. No consumed approval reuse.
proactiveReview.readiness: 36 focused checks plus peak review-wire stress passed and historical actual requests reconstruct exactly. Exact committed STRICT/Redis/CI/CodeQL/Preview/Browser qualification and fresh configuration gates remain mandatory; no live v4 claim.
